verdict.rationale: n8n documents a core Webhook node (n8n-docs-21) that lets workflows receive and react to incoming webhook events. A hands-on user confirms building webhook-initiated tasks in production (n8n-comm-18). Missing for 10: detail in the evidence beyond the Webhook node page title (event payload handling, auth/signature verification, retries), and any evidence that n8n emits webhooks for its own platform events (e.g., execution completed/failed) for outside subscribers.
